summary.zh: 分析竞争对手与差异化机会

description.zh: 用波特五力、蓝海战略和定位图梳理竞争格局，找出差异化机会与可持续优势。适合评估竞争对手、确定产品定位，或为融资材料准备竞争分析。
description.en: Uses Porter's Five Forces, Blue Ocean Strategy, and positioning maps to explore competitors and surface differentiation and durable advantages. Fits competitor reviews, positioning work, or investor materials.
